title: Rent Increase Limits
requirement: Landlords can only raise rent by a certain amount each year, which cannot be more than 3% of the current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
key_value: lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change
citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

title: Just Cause Evictions
requirement: Landlords must have a valid reason to evict a tenant, such as not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you.
